name: False-positive check — legit conversation mentioning OTP + investment
notes: Must stay Low: legitimate_otp_context counter-signal fires; keywords alone never panic the system.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Beta, main apne mobile banking se login kar raha thi, OTP aaya hai use this code to log in to your own account wala step samajh nahi aya

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Abbu woh code sirf aap ke apne login ka hai, kisi ko batana nahi hai. Sirf app mein daal dein.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Ho gaya, login ho gaya. Shukriya beta.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Aur haan, jo prize lottery ka message aya tha kal, us par click mat karna. Woh scam hota hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Nahi beta, main aise messages delete kar deta hoon. Chalo phir Sunday ko milte hain.
